title: Story Intention Statement
description: Authoring-time schema for the mandatory G1.5 Story Intention Gate. Runtime packages may include only a short summary.

protagonist_identity.description: Who the player/protagonist is in dramatic terms.

core_goal.description: What the protagonist is actively trying to do.

core_conflict.description: The main opposing pressure: environment, relationship, antagonist, flaw, duty, or dilemma.

core_question.description: The question the whole story asks through scenes and choices.

emotional_anchor.description: The feeling the game should leave in the player.

core_intention.description: The story's intended meaning or answer. It need not be morally correct or universal.

gameplay_expression.description: How choices, values, gates, failures, or loops express the intention.

choice_pressure.description: What kind of hesitation or value pressure choices should create.

role_in_intention.description: What this character represents, challenges, tempts, protects, or misunderstands.
